headline: 1 metric(s) improved beyond the noise; none degraded.

comparisons.label: Control delay
comparisons.explanation: The difference of -17.00 has a 95% confidence interval of [-18.42, -15.58], which excludes zero, so the change is larger than the sampling noise.

method: Welch's unequal-variance t-test with a 95% confidence interval on the difference of means.
method_caveats: Demand is not controlled for: traffic may have changed independently of the signal change.
This is an observational before/after comparison, not a randomised trial.
Metrics are compared independently; no correction is applied for multiple comparisons.
